description: Matte graphite capture instrument for browser extension popup, options page, context menu actions, and store listing.
name: nougen-capture

provenance.note: Existing semantic token names and workbench selectors.
Graphite and amber palette; local Ollama draft, Codex review.
200 Web Store extensions rated >=4.5 from 20 category listings; not a global ranking

icon hue neutral 51/blue 43 of 200; first screenshot light 85, mid 68, dark 47; 86/200 names use a tagline separator; median name 28 chars, description 99 chars; 22/200 mention AI; screenshot count median 10 per listing (range 1-12, saturates at 12, includes carousel promo tiles)
Popup states (capture ok/not captured/not configured/offline) must read the server's captured flag, never HTTP status.
Authentication token must never be shown after save; display masked verification status instead.
Store title formatted as 'Brand: Function' under ~30 chars and store summary near ~100 chars derived from top-200 medians.
In-extension UI retains dark graphite surfaces, while light canvas is permitted only for store hero art based on screenshot brightness analysis.
Reject AI badges and tags in copy, aligning with the observed 22/200 low-incidence pattern and instrument voice.
